g.text: Single 4-20 mA channel - wiring reference (NOT a tested product)

g.desc: Single 4-20 mA channel - wiring reference (NOT a tested product)

g.text: Loop: +24 V -> F1 -> J2.1 -> 2-wire transmitter -> J2.2 -> R1 shunt -> 0 V

g.desc: Loop: +24 V -> F1 -> J2.1 -> 2-wire transmitter -> J2.2 -> R1 shunt -> 0 V

g.text: ADS1115 PGA +/-4.096 V (gain 1) at VDD 3.3 V: inputs above VDD+0.3 V are not allowed, so

g.desc: ADS1115 PGA +/-4.096 V (gain 1) at VDD 3.3 V: inputs above VDD+0.3 V are not allowed, so

g.text: full scale is effectively 3.3 V; 21 mA still leaves 150 mV headroom.

g.desc: full scale is effectively 3.3 V; 21 mA still leaves 150 mV headroom.

g.text: 20 mA: P = I^2 R = 60 mW (use >= 0.25 W, 0.1 %, 25 ppm/K or better).

g.desc: 20 mA: P = I^2 R = 60 mW (use >= 0.25 W, 0.1 %, 25 ppm/K or better).

g.text: Loop burden at 20 mA: 3.0 V across R1 (+ PTC/wiring); transmitter sees the rest of 24 V.

g.desc: Loop burden at 20 mA: 3.0 V across R1 (+ PTC/wiring); transmitter sees the rest of 24 V.

g.text: R2 + C1: fc = 1/(2 pi 4.7k 100n) ~ 340 Hz anti-alias / RF filter; R2 limits clamp current:

g.desc: R2 + C1: fc = 1/(2 pi 4.7k 100n) ~ 340 Hz anti-alias / RF filter; R2 limits clamp current:

g.text: worst case (transmitter shorted, 24 V on LOOP-): (24 - 3.6) V / 4.7k ~ 4.3 mA < 10 mA abs-max.

g.desc: worst case (transmitter shorted, 24 V on LOOP-): (24 - 3.6) V / 4.7k ~ 4.3 mA < 10 mA abs-max.

g.text: D3 (BAT54S) clamps AIN0 to the 3.3 V rail / GND; D1, D2 absorb field surges (choose standoff >= supply).

g.desc: D3 (BAT54S) clamps AIN0 to the 3.3 V rail / GND; D1, D2 absorb field surges (choose standoff >= supply).

g.text: F1 PTC: with a shorted transmitter R1 sees 24 V / 150 R = 160 mA (3.8 W) until F1 trips - pick a

g.desc: F1 PTC: with a shorted transmitter R1 sees 24 V / 150 R = 160 mA (3.8 W) until F1 trips - pick a

g.text: PTC/fuse that opens fast enough for the shunt's pulse rating (see docs/wiring-single-channel.md).

g.desc: PTC/fuse that opens fast enough for the shunt's pulse rating (see docs/wiring-single-channel.md).

g.text: 3-wire transmitter: +24 V -> sensor V+, sensor 0 V -> GND (0 V), sensor OUT -> J2.2. J2.1 not used.

g.desc: 3-wire transmitter: +24 V -> sensor V+, sensor 0 V -> GND (0 V), sensor OUT -> J2.2. J2.1 not used.

g.text: 4-wire / self-powered: connect its loop output + to J2.2 and its - to GND only if its output

g.desc: 4-wire / self-powered: connect its loop output + to J2.2 and its - to GND only if its output

g.text: is isolated or shares this 0 V; otherwise use a loop isolator.

g.desc: is isolated or shares this 0 V; otherwise use a loop isolator.

g.text: Common ground: the 24 V supply 0 V, ADS1115 GND and Pi GND are one net.

g.desc: Common ground: the 24 V supply 0 V, ADS1115 GND and Pi GND are one net.

g.text: Recommended: power U1 from a GPIO-switchable 3.3 V rail so the I2C bus can be recovered after a brown-out.

g.desc: Recommended: power U1 from a GPIO-switchable 3.3 V rail so the I2C bus can be recovered after a brown-out.

g.text: R3/R4 are DNP: the Raspberry Pi already has pull-ups on GPIO2/GPIO3.

g.desc: R3/R4 are DNP: the Raspberry Pi already has pull-ups on GPIO2/GPIO3.
